messages:
ellie: Heads up — my work MacBook (asset MB-0921) just triggered an EDR alert. It quarantined a file and killed a process. I was on calls all afternoon, not sure when this started.
sec-bot: [EDR ALERT] id=EDR-1802468100 type=SuspiciousBrowserHelper severity=medium user=ellie asset=MB-0921 link=https://edr.redwood.example/alerts/EDR-1802468100 path=/Users/ellie/Library/Application Support/Helper/update_helper pid=4821 sha256=3f5a9b2e5c6f7d8e9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2
raj: @ellie thanks for flagging. Can you confirm device is on company VPN right now and if you saved any credentials or SSO popups? Also need serial and local IP if possible.
ellie: Yes I'm on corp-vpn (nyc-1). Serial is C02XG0H4LVDL. Local IP 10.12.8.32. I did a browser extension update yesterday (FormFill+) but didn't enter creds outside SSO.
raj: OK. I see the EDR notes — quarantined file /Users/ellie/...update_helper and a LaunchAgent entry observed. @matt can you confirm quarantine action and run a remote deep scan+live response to grab process tree and recent network connections?
matt: Confirmed quarantine and process kill at 16:22 UTC. Running deep scan now (edrctl scan --deep) and a live response to pull process tree and open sockets. Will also check LaunchAgents: `~/Library/LaunchAgents/*.plist`.
sec-bot: Scheduled YARA sweep for asset MB-0921 (rulepack: infra-suspicious-helpers). Full telemetry stream being archived to s3://redwood-edr-telemetry/MB-0921/1802468100/ :eyes: 
it-helpdesk: FYI I sent ellie a quick checklist to not reboot and to leave the laptop connected. Also asked them to upload any suspicious downloads to the sandbox if present.
raj: If possible capture `sudo sysdiagnose` and `/var/log/install.log` artifacts. Also export Chrome/Edge extension list and check for unsigned helpers. We'll need hashes of any LaunchAgent and the quarantined file.
ellie: I uploaded the quarantined file to the sandbox link Matt sent. Also attached a screenshot of the extension list.
matt: Scan results: no additional malware files found, but LaunchAgent `com.apple.helper.update.plist` had a suspicious `ProgramArguments` pointing to `update_helper` in Application Support. Hash of quarantined file sha256=3f5a9b2e... (same as alert). No active persistence after quarantine.
sre-oncall: Checked network telemetry — no large outbound transfers from MB-0921 in the 24h window. There are a few DNS lookups to `cdn-helpers.example[.]net` from yesterday evening, domain flagged as low-reputation.
raj: Good. Next steps: 1) preserve current artifacts for 48h, 2) rotate session tokens and any keys the user touched (SSO tokens), 3) check Vault/KMS access for the user in the last 48h, 4) run a full disk forensic image if any sign of exfil. I'll open an incident record INC-2026-014 and attach artifacts. @it-helpdesk please schedule a reimage for MB-0921 tomorrow if we find persistence.
it-helpdesk: Noted. Tentatively scheduled reimage window 04/12 0900-1100 ET, pending confirmation.
ellie: Quick q — does rotating SSO tokens require any help from me?
raj: We'll rotate at the identity provider layer — you don't need to change local passwords but expect a forced sign-in on devices and apps. We'll also check KMS audit logs for key usage; if anything odd we'll escalate.
matt: For completeness I ran `osquery` query to list LaunchAgents and unsigned apps and attached results to the incident. All other company apps show valid signatures.
sec-bot: Forensic artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-edr-telemetry/MB-0921/1802468100/{sysdiag,tcpdump,osquery}.
raj: Preliminary triage conclusion: suspicious browser helper dropped a helper binary and a LaunchAgent, EDR quarantined before persistence could complete. No evidence of successful data exfil. Actions: rotate SSO tokens, schedule reimage as precaution, continue artifact retention. Owner: raj.
ellie: Thanks. I'll leave the laptop online and available for imaging.
sre-oncall: I'll keep checking network logs for 72h and add any anomalies to INC-2026-014.
it-helpdesk: Reimage confirmed 04/12 0930 ET. Will factory-reset & reinstall standard image, then re-enroll in EDR.
raj: Post-actions — can infra/security confirm audit logging has the following enabled for this user: Auth events, KMS decrypt logs, Vault access logs for last 7 days? We need retention proof for compliance.
matt: I'll request teams to preserve KMS decrypt audit logs and escalate to infra for retention snapshot.
raj: Closing note: no PII found in telemetry, no large egress, recommend reimage + token rotation as final containment. Reopen thread if we see follow-up alerts. :lock:
